fields.System.Title: TRF-201 — Allocate and pick for a transfer
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker at the origin, I want transfer picking to work exactly like customer order
picking, so that I do not learn a second process for the same physical job.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a transfer, then allocation reserves stock using the same locking and FEFO rules
  • as [OUT-2](../../features/OUT/OUT-2-allocation.md).
  • - Given allocation, then pick tasks are generated, sequenced, and scan-confirmed exactly
  • as in [OUT-4](../../features/OUT/OUT-4-picking.md).
  • - Given a short pick on a transfer, then the remainder is resolved explicitly, as in
  • [OUT-404](../OUT/OUT-404-short-pick.md).
  • - Given the reused flow, then it is a service call into outbound, not duplicated code.
  • - Given the picked stock, then it moves to a transfer staging location, not to
  • VIRT-CUSTOMER.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, outbound, inventory |
| Tables | transfer_line, reservation, pick_task |
| Risks | Duplicating outbound logic instead of reusing it ([doc 04 §6](../../../docs/04-modules.md)) |
| Tests | integration · concurrency |
